L’opérateur mobile algérien franchit une: The Algerian mobile operator is taking a new step forward with the launch of "Campuce Jobs", a digital service integrated into the "Student Campuce" program. Objective: to help students find flexible jobs (part-time, freelance) without sacrificing their studies.
Finis les casse-tête entre cours magistr: No more headaches between lectures and making ends meet at the end of the month. This Monday, Djezzy officially unveiled "Campuce Jobs", an online platform designed to enable Algerian students to balance university life and professional activity. Accessible via the "Student Campuce" program, this tool aims to address a real need: generating income without jeopardizing academic success.
Au-delà du simple complément financier,: Beyond a simple financial supplement, the initiative aims to familiarize young people with the corporate world. By engaging in paid work during their studies, they can compare their theoretical knowledge with real-world realities, develop concrete skills, and prepare for their professional future with greater peace of mind.
Une passerelle numérique entre étudiants: A digital bridge between students and recruiters
Conçu comme une interface simple et rapi: Designed as a simple and fast interface, "Campuce Jobs" allows university students to showcase their profile and apply in just a few clicks to various offers: internships, one-off assignments, and entry-level junior jobs. These listings are provided by the network of partner companies in the "Student Campuce" program, guaranteeing a pool of serious and suitable opportunities.
Djezzy n’oublie pas ceux qui ont choisi: Djezzy hasn't forgotten those who have chosen a more independent path. The platform dedicates a specific space for student self-entrepreneurs, particularly holders of the card issued by the National Agency for Self-Employment (ANAE). They will be able to search for freelance assignments independently in an environment designed for their needs.
Avec « Campuce Jobs », l’opérateur confi: With "Campuce Jobs", the operator confirms its mission as a corporate citizen committed to the national economy. By directly connecting lecture halls with business needs, Djezzy is betting on a better prepared, more autonomous generation ready to meet the challenges of tomorrow.
